item.title: CVE-2026-68539 · fulgur allows Unbounded string-set value accumulation causes memory/CPU exhaustion (denial of service)
item.description: `fulgur` converts untrusted HTML/CSS into PDF, commonly on a server that processes input supplied by many tenants.
